name: Desktop Cowboy Assistant
source:
Aero the cowboy dog is ready to be your rootin'-tootin' virtual assistant. He can help you browse the internet, remember your tasks and appointments, and guide you through the wild wild west that is the internet. With his charming accent, beautiful 3D visuals, and hundreds of lines of dialogue, you are sure to fall in love with this little cowboy.

Please be aware that a few bugs have been noted in his programming. Aero has been known to become promiscuous or try to initiate sexual contact. If this occurs, please close the program and report the bug below with details and how to reproduce it.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/dektop-cowboy-assistant]Itch.io[/url]]
